title: Excellent transportation services while in Granada!!
text: Rafa of SunTravel Granada we absolutely amazing and made our trip from Granada to Malaga absolutely seamless and pleasant. We used him again after using his services from the airport. He was so professional, friendly, knowledgeable and his car was spotless and so comfortable! Perfection!
author: Roving45016940474

title: Simply the best!
text: Thank you Rafa for the best transportation from Granada to our ship in Malaga. You made everything so easy and shared your knowledge and experiences along the journey. I have travelled in Europe and Asia and you are the absolute best!  See you when we return to beautiful Andalusia.
author: 3wendiw

title: Great service, splendid trip.
text: This was excellent in every way. Immaculately clean and comfortable vehicle, charming and highly professional driver, whole journey smooth and on time. The rote offered wonderful views, so this trip was a treat in itself. Good value, and highly recommended.
author: petermR4665UB

title: Recommended reliable taxi
text: Because our flight was changed we had to take a taxi from Granada to Malaga. We found Rafael via TripAdvisor. He was fantastic. Easy to reach. Stayed in good contact and gave good advice about the departure time. Nice comfortable taxi. many thanks for the pleasant and efficient support.
author: patrician910

title: Dependable transport company!
text: this is an excellent company - Rafa communicated immediately and answered all my many questions as to timing.  The car showed up early and the driver loaded up all our bags.  I highly recommend this company!
author: 120ynk

title: Professional
text: Arranging transportation was easy. Adjusting transportation was easy. The company kept me informed of the changes I asked for so I was never anxious. The van arrived exactly on time. Our driver was helpful and courteous. Most importantly, we arrived on time and made our flight. Thank you for keeping the final stage of my trip worry free and enjoyable!
author: Leslie_S

title: Excellent transportation
text: Excellent and respectful door to door service from Malaga Airport to La Esperanza in Granada, as well as service from La Esperanza to the Granada Airport.
author: L3334YJmarias

title: Great experience
text: Wonderful experience with Rafael- thank you! We had a dog with us and Rafael was kind and friendly- very accepting of our pet. Thank you! Five stars

title: VIP transfers for regular travelers
text: We hired Rafa for two of our transportation needs, and he was absolutely amazing and has a beautiful Mercedes sprinter van.  He worked with me a few weeks in advance to plan out a Beautiful route from Granada to Marbella with a stop for lunch and shopping.  Our experience was so wonderful and elevated we hired him several times for transportation needs. His prices are very reasonable for the level of service and quality of the vehicle and his knowledge of the local areas for is a huge bonus.
